channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Paul Pierce | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Paul Pierce from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Paul Pierce, De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Kevin Garnett:

“I like the young Spurs. They look good, bro. Dylan look good. Paul Pierce: They should look to get a trade for D Fox. I mean, I like the core with the young. I just like the young guys. I like the lineup of the guys that’s around the same age to grow together.”

Kevin Garnett on Paul Pierce, De'Aaron Fox, Oct 25, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Al Jefferson on Paul Pierce, Doc Rivers, Chris Wallace
item.description:
Al Jefferson:

“That was Doc Rivers’ first year. Let me tell you what happened. This was in May, right? I’m flying to Boston for my first NBA workout, and I have no idea what to expect. Now, it’s 90 degrees in Mississippi, so I’m wearing a Paul Pierce jersey with the sleeves cut off and some shorts. I show up in Boston, and it’s cold as hell. Chris Wallace, the GM, had just bought a new car and lost it in the airport parking lot. We walked around for 45 minutes trying to find his car. Finally, we had to call for one of those airport carts to drive us around until we found it.”

Al Jefferson on Paul Pierce, Doc Rivers, Chris Wallace, Dec 19, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Ray Allen on Paul Pierce, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
“I think, for the most part, time has passed, and it’s that idea of thought that as you age, you make amends with your past follies and you forgive old enemies [Paul Pierce and Kevin Garnett],”

Ray Allen on Paul Pierce, Kevin Garnett, Oct 24, 2024. Source: Heavy.com.

item.title: Mario Chalmers on Paul Pierce
item.description:
Chalmers tells Scoop B Radio.

“I talk crap to Paul Pierce and he talks crap to me. It’s always gonna be a rivalry.”

Mario Chalmers on Paul Pierce, Sep 30, 2024. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Kwame Brown on Paul Pierce, LeBron James
item.description:
Kwame Brown on LeBron James:

“But the problem is, when he plays teams like Chicago or Boston, who have real solid principles, he has trouble. And so the old-school players wouldn't have any trouble with LeBron because, at 39, he should have developed a mid-range and a post game, and he still hasn't yet. He still has the athletic ability to just go 94 feet — which, I don't know how, but he still has it. Butif he didn't have this athleticism, his game really hasn't evolved outside of a three and putting his head down and going to the basket. He doesn't go like Paul Pierce, getting to a spot, pulling up. Those are the things you normally see out of a superstar player.”

Kwame Brown on Paul Pierce, LeBron James, Sep 22, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Paul Pierce, Eddie House, Leon Powe
item.description:
Kendrick Perkins:

“Was I the only 2008 member missing from the duck boat? No, I wasn’t. (Eddie) House, my guy, he was there. Leon Powe, great friend of mine as well, he was there. Scal was there and Paul (Pierce) was there. There was still 11 other guys missing. And to be honest with you, if I would’ve gotten an invite, which I didn’t — I didn’t know we was supposed to — but anyways, nine times out of 10, I would’ve turned it down.… That’s not our moment. That’s 2024′s moment. Let those guys have their moment.”

Kendrick Perkins on Paul Pierce, Eddie House, Leon Powe, Jun 25, 2024. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Lamar Odom on Paul Pierce
item.description:
“I know Paul Pierce is happy and it kind of makes me sick to see him gloat and be that happy because that team is about to win,”

Lamar Odom on Paul Pierce, Jun 14, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Naz Reid on Paul Pierce, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Naz Reid on Anthony Edwards coming back from injury:

“I called it a Paul Pierce moment. I’m never really worried. He’s tough enough, he’ll come back. That’s kind of like a joke that I always tell with him and Kyle, like, ‘You ain’t tired,’ or ‘You’re not hurt.’”

Naz Reid on Paul Pierce, Anthony Edwards, Feb 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Paul Pierce, Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
Brian Robb:Rajon Rondo on Joe Mazzulla sending an email out to Celtics alumni inviting them to come back more:

“Paul (Pierce) called me at like 3 in the morning. He was like, ‘They want us back.’ I’m like, ‘Hello?’”

Rajon Rondo on Paul Pierce, Joe Mazzulla, Oct 20, 2023. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Steve Pagliuca on Paul Pierce, Jrue Holiday
item.description:
Celtics governor Steve Pagliuca on today's practice with Jrue Holiday:

“Paul Pierce turned to us and said he’s never seen an NBA practice in his whole entire career that they went that hard, that fast, for so long.”

Steve Pagliuca on Paul Pierce, Jrue Holiday, Oct 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Tony Allen on Paul Pierce
item.description:
He explained that Pierce had it, and so he hopes that the current Celtics superstar was able to get a better insight of that after his recent workout with The Truth.

“That seek and destroy mentality. I used to look at P [Pierce] and see three things that were going to happen. Either he was going to get fouled, he was going to score, or he was going to get somebody a bucket,”

Tony Allen on Paul Pierce, Sep 19, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Tony Allen on Paul Pierce, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
“That’s that seek and destroy mentality… I'm not saying Tatum don't got it, but [Pierce] working out with him. I think that's good insight,”

Tony Allen on Paul Pierce, Jayson Tatum, Sep 19, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Sam Cassell on Paul Pierce, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
“It’s ain’t about making conference finals as a member of the Celtics, the coaching staff and the players. It’s all about winning the championship. That’s the tradition in Boston — win the championship. Playing for guys who won previously for us, Kevin Garnett, Paul Pierce, Russell, Cousy, Maxwell, the history goes on. It’s about them. That’s the thing that our guys have to understand. It’s a pride thing.”

Sam Cassell on Paul Pierce, Kevin Garnett, Jul 11, 2023. Source: Celtics Blog.

item.title: Marcin Gortat on Paul Pierce
item.description:
While Gortat would get Durant to bite on his pregame and in-game schtick, the Polish hammer said he witnessed a few instances when Westbrook would go up to his own teammates to tell them to stop laughing no matter what the score was.

“I just got to tell you, I love that. That's a Paul Pierce attitude. He's a little feisty too,”

Marcin Gortat on Paul Pierce, Apr 28, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Chris Paul on Paul Pierce, Chauncey Billups, Grant Hill
item.description:
Paul, 33, told The Undefeated.

“And I have had the opportunity to play with a lot of great vets. I played with Paul Pierce in his last year in the NBA. I played with Grant Hill his last year in the NBA. I also had an opportunity to play with ‘Chaunce’ [Chauncey Billups]. “Some things go unsaid at times. But as a teammate, you pay attention. You see it with your eyes. So, with ‘Ne,’ it’s his work [ethic]. He didn’t play in our first two playoff games, but he was in the gym, in the weight room and taking care of his body. As a young player, you may not take notice or pay attention to it. But for someone like me who wants that longevity and wants to continue to play, I have the utmost respect for him.”

Chris Paul on Paul Pierce, Chauncey Billups, Grant Hill, May 3, 2019. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Paul Pierce
item.description:
Kidd said,

“If we had a bunch of really young guys, I’d be worried, but I know with KG and Paul (Pierce) here, it’ll be OK and they won’t let anyone get out of line.”

Jason Kidd on Paul Pierce, Feb 28, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Paul Pierce, Ray Allen, Doc Rivers, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
“Your dad, [Doc Rivers], was an NBA coach, you've been able to work out with Paul Pierce and [Kevin Garnett] and Ray Allen and all that. We felt like you had the upperhand. He had the NBA socks when we were playing. We were thinking about all of this stuff. You had access to all this stuff and we didn't. We were kind of envious of it. His game was like super far advanced from everybody else; his handle, his floater, everything. In a way, we were like 'man, this dude.' We were kind of jealous of him for a little bit.”

Bradley Beal on Paul Pierce, Ray Allen, Doc Rivers, Kevin Garnett, Sep 28, 2018. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Ray Allen on Paul Pierce, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
Allen's first reference to the Celtics drew loud cheers from fans seated in the balcony.

“In my 12th year, I paired up with a couple of Hall of Famers in Paul Pierce and Kevin Garnett,”

Ray Allen on Paul Pierce, Kevin Garnett, Sep 8, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jason Terry on Paul Pierce, Dirk Nowitzki, Jason Kidd, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
“Then, for the next 15 minutes, he did something I’ve never seen from Dirk Nowitzki, Kevin Garnett, Jason Kidd or Paul Pierce. And he was working on defensive coverages. No one works on defense by themselves. This kid is way ahead of the curve.”

Jason Terry on Paul Pierce, Dirk Nowitzki, Jason Kidd, Kevin Garnett, Feb 15, 2018. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Paul Pierce
item.description:
Brian Robb:Doc on Paul Pierce's legacy:

“I would say this: In this day and time, he stayed. You think about it, no one sticks.... Wewere pretty bad for a stretch and even before, yet he stayed and then it worked out for him. I just think about his loyalty to this organization is amazing.”

Doc Rivers on Paul Pierce, Feb 11, 2018. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Paul Pierce
item.description:
Jay King:Doc Rivers:

“Someone asked me recently, what is the one word if you could come up with (just one to describe Pierce). You would say Truth. I would say clutch.”

Doc Rivers on Paul Pierce, Feb 11, 2018. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Paul Pierce
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Doc on Pierce:

“We bumped heads a couple of times. But at the end of the day, I'm sitting in my office, then Paul walks in & he says, 'We're good. We're gonna do this together.'I was grateful because we live in a time now, with superstar players, as a coach, that means a lot.”

Doc Rivers on Paul Pierce, Feb 11, 2018. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Tony Allen on Paul Pierce
item.description:
Gary Washburn:Tony Allen explains benefit of being picked on by Paul Pierce:

“He was good bully because I probably might leave practice and go with him and get a nice Louis Vuitton bookbag or something. He was just that type of guy, big-hearted, tough love. Salute to Paul Pierce. The Truth.”

Tony Allen on Paul Pierce, Jan 21, 2018. Source: Twitter @GwashburnGlobe.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Paul Pierce, LeBron James, Dwyane Wade, Carmelo Anthony, Larry Bird
item.description:
“You got LeBron. You got [Dwyane Wade]. You got [Carmelo Anthony]. You got Paul Pierce. You got Larry Bird. You got Dr. J all in a room. It’s my turn to be in there with them and enjoy being one of the best players in the world. It wasn’t the fact that I took it from LeBron and he’s gone now. Obviously he’s still around.”

Kevin Durant on Paul Pierce, LeBron James, Dwyane Wade, Carmelo Anthony, Larry Bird, Dec 26, 2017. Source: San Jose Mercury-News.

item.title: Gary Vitti on Paul Pierce
item.description:
“I told the officials what we were going to do. As soon as we fouled, I walked out on the court to get him. And I said, ‘You want a chair?’ And he said, ‘No, I’m walking off.’ And he walked all the way back to the training room on his own power. That was a message to Paul Pierce.‘Cause you remember in the (2008) Finals, Pierce looked like he got shot by a sniper, rolling around, writhing in pain? They take him off on a chair and he comes back and plays and they beat us? That was Kobe’s (bleep) you to Paul Pierce.”

Gary Vitti on Paul Pierce, Dec 18, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Marcus Morris on Paul Pierce
item.description:
Adam Kaufman‏:Marcus Morris on trade:

“It was unexpected...but how could I be upset about going to Boston #Celtics? Paul Pierce is my favorite player.”

Marcus Morris on Paul Pierce, Jul 19, 2017. Source: Twitter.

item.title: LeBron James on Paul Pierce, Ray Allen, Doc Rivers, Rajon Rondo, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
LeBron James:

“So, it's going to be very challenging. Those guys are going to challenge me. They're going to challenge our ballclub. This is a high-powered teamand I've played against some other (stiff competition). I've played against Ray (Allen), KG (Kevin Garnett), Paul (Pierce), (Rajon) Rondo and Doc (Rivers). So, it's going to be very challenging not only on me mentally, but on our ballclub and on our franchise.”

LeBron James on Paul Pierce, Ray Allen, Doc Rivers, Rajon Rondo, Kevin Garnett, May 28, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Chris Paul on Paul Pierce
item.description:
Spencer Checketts:Chris Paul:

“During a TO, I looked over at Truth (Paul Pierce) and said we aren't ending your career in Utah.”

Chris Paul on Paul Pierce, Apr 29, 2017. Source: Twitter @1280Spence.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Paul Pierce
item.description:
Adam Himmelsbach:Brad Stevens on Pierce:

“It was a special day...it's special for [the players] to see it. Obviously he's one of the icons of Boston sports.”

Brad Stevens on Paul Pierce, Feb 5, 2017. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Paul Pierce
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Doc on Pierce's retirement tour:

“He's handled this perfectly. He's been so good with out young guys. We call it the Paul Pierce school.”

Doc Rivers on Paul Pierce, Feb 5, 2017. Source: Twitter @celtics.
